sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording; refer Policy Schedule

room_rent.note: Room rent limit deferred to Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table. Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken.

icu.display: No cap (proportionate deduction not applicable for ICU)
icu.note: Policy wording explicitly states proportionate deductions are not applicable for ICU charges.

copayment.display: None (base); 20% if age 61+ at inception; 15% if non-PPN hospital chosen under PPN Discount option
copayment.note: Co-pay of unspecified % applies if insured/eldest insured is 61+ at first policy inception (exact % in Product Benefit Table). Additional 15% co-pay if PPN Discount optional cover chosen and treatment taken outside PPN network.

sub_limits.note: Section C.I.(j) provides sub-limits for listed illnesses/conditions as per Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table. Joint replacement surgery has 36-month waiting period for Standard Plan specifically.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). No maternity benefit mentioned for any plan variant.

cumulative_bonus.note: Accrues on claim-free renewal; reduced by 10% of SI on a claim year. Max cap 50% of SI.

restoration.note: Reload of Sum Insured available once per policy year for subsequent claims only; not for same illness/injury as prior claim; not for first claim of year. Unrelated illness trigger implied.

pre_hosp.note: Number of days deferred to Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table.

post_hosp.note: Number of days deferred to Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table.

domiciliary.note: Asthma, bronchitis, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, arthritis, gout, nephritis, diarrhoea, psychiatric disorders, pyrexia of unknown origin excluded under domiciliary.

ayush.note: AYUSH in-patient hospitalization covered up to limits in Policy Schedule. AYUSH OPD also covered under OPD benefit. Treatment must be within India.

organ_donor.note: Only harvesting expenses of donor covered; screening, pre/post-hosp of donor, organ transport not covered.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered; limit deferred to Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table. Air ambulance covered under Domestic/International Emergency Assistance (inbuilt additional benefit).

modern_treatments.note: Policy wording does not explicitly list modern/robotic treatments as covered. Some specific treatments (RF ablation, cyber knife, femto laser, SMILE surgery) are excluded under Section D.II.43. No explicit modern treatment cover clause found.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable expenses listed in Annexure I are excluded. However, consumables are waived for Home Treatment (C.I.k) and Nursing at Home optional benefit.

global_cover.note: Section D.II.50 excludes treatment outside India. International Emergency Assistance (air ambulance/evacuation) is inbuilt but covers emergency evacuation only, not treatment costs abroad.

notable_exclusions: Parkinson's disease, external congenital anomalies, STDs (non-HIV), stem cell therapy, dental (non-accident), treatment outside India, RF ablation/cyber knife/SMILE surgery
optional_riders: Room Upgrade, PPN Discount (15% co-pay outside PPN, 10% premium discount), Nursing at Home, Lifestyle Support Equipment, Portable Medical Equipment, Advance Health Check-up
insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
